approaches_tried.approach: command -v for stub-PATH binary resolution in masked-sha256sum test case
approaches_tried.reason: this shell environment exports a `grep` shell function; `command -v grep` resolves to the bare name 'grep' rather than a path, producing a dangling symlink. Fixed with `type -P`, which looks only in PATH for a real executable.

approaches_tried.approach: nested task-ref-ok:begin/:end wrapper around the two new test cases to satisfy the PreToolUse hook (which scans only the Edit's new_string)
approaches_tried.reason: the nested :end closed the file's pre-existing outer exempt block early, un-exempting every later case's --task N usage and failing the repo-wide check-task-references.sh lint. Fixed by keeping only a no-op nested :begin (redundant with the already-active outer block) and dropping the nested :end.
